name: Collapsing Glomerulopathy
aliases: Collapsing Variant of Focal Segmental Glomerulosclerosis

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Histopathological Diagnostic Criteria for Collapsing Glomerulopathy

criteria.description: Collapse of glomerular capillary tufts with wrinkling and retraction of the basement membrane
Proliferation and hypertrophy of overlying podocytes
Rapid progression of renal dysfunction with elevated serum creatinine

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of glomerular capillary tuft collapse and podocyte hyperplasia on renal biopsy
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires renal biopsy with characteristic histopathological findings.

pathognomonic.notes: Marked decline in glomerular filtration rate over weeks to months

common.notes: Peripheral and periorbital edema due to hypoalbuminemia
Elevated blood pressure often accompanies renal impairment
Presence of red blood cells in urine without gross hematuria

occasional.notes: Loss of appetite related to uremia
Anemia of chronic disease or renal origin

rare.notes: Rarely reported in advanced renal failure
Secondary to fluid overload in renal failure

laboratory: Elevated serum creatinine and blood urea nitrogen
imaging: Renal ultrasound showing normal or enlarged kidneys
No specific imaging findings diagnostic for CG
genetic: Association with APOL1 high-risk variants in individuals of African descent
other: Renal biopsy demonstrating glomerular capillary tuft collapse and podocyte hyperplasia

distinguishingFeatures: Segmental sclerosis without capillary tuft collapse
Slower progression compared to collapsing variant
Absence of podocyte hyperplasia or tuft collapse
Mesangial cell proliferation and basement membrane thickening

redFlags: Rapidly worsening renal function over weeks
Nephrotic syndrome refractory to standard therapies
Presence of collapsing lesions on renal biopsy
references: D'Agati VD, et al. Pathology of collapsing glomerulopathy. Kidney Int. 2016;90(2):281-289.
Kopp JB, et al. APOL1 genetic variants in focal segmental glomerulosclerosis and HIV-associated nephropathy. Nat Rev Nephrol. 2013;9(6): 345-354.
Fogo AB. Approach to renal biopsy. Am J Kidney Dis. 2003;42(4):826-836.
